Identify the common ratio $r = 1 + 0.02 = 1.02$ and the $n$th term formula $u_n = ar^{n-1}$:
$$u_{12} = 8000(1.02)^{12 - 1} = 8000(1.02)^{11}$$

Calculate the salt obtained in week 12 (to 3 significant figures):
$$u_{12} \approx 8000(1.24337) \approx 9946.99 \approx 9950 \text{ kg}$$

Apply the geometric progression sum formula $S_n = \frac{a(r^n - 1)}{r - 1}$ with $n = 12$:
$$S_{12} = \frac{8000\left(1.02^{12} - 1\right)}{1.02 - 1} = \frac{8000\left(1.02^{12} - 1\right)}{0.02} = 400000\left(1.02^{12} - 1\right)$$

Evaluate the total sum (to 3 significant figures):
$$S_{12} \approx 400000(0.268242) \approx 107297 \approx 107000 \text{ kg}$$
